ayahs.textArabic: اِقْتَرَبَتِ السَّاعَةُ وَانْشَقَّ الْقَمَرُ
ayahs.textLatin: Iqtarabatis-sā‘atu wansyaqqal-qamar(u).
ayahs.textEnglish: THE LAST HOUR draws near, and the moon is split asunder!

ayahs.textArabic: وَاِنْ يَّرَوْا اٰيَةً يُّعْرِضُوْا وَيَقُوْلُوْا سِحْرٌ مُّسْتَمِرٌّ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa iy yarau āyatay yu‘riḍū wa yaqūlū siḥrum mustamirr(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: But if they [who reject all thought of the Last Hour] were to see a sign [of its approach], they would turn aside and say, “An ever-recurring delusion!” –

ayahs.textArabic: وَكَذَّبُوْا وَاتَّبَعُوْٓا اَهْوَاۤءَهُمْ وَكُلُّ اَمْرٍ مُّسْتَقِرٌّ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa każżabū wattaba‘ū ahwā'ahum wa kullu amrim mustaqirr(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: for they are bent on giving it the lie, being always wont to follow their own desires. Yet everything reveals its truth in the end.

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَقَدْ جَاۤءَهُمْ مِّنَ الْاَنْۢبَاۤءِ مَا فِيْهِ مُزْدَجَرٌۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa laqad jā'ahum minal-ambā'i mā fīhi muzdajar(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: And withal, there has come unto them many a tiding that should have restrained [their arrogance]:

ayahs.textArabic: حِكْمَةٌ ۢ بَالِغَةٌ فَمَا تُغْنِ النُّذُرُۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Ḥikmatum bāligatun famā tugnin-nużur(u).
ayahs.textEnglish: far-reaching wisdom [was held out to them]: but [since] all warnings have been of no avail,

ayahs.textArabic: فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ ۘ يَوْمَ يَدْعُ الدَّاعِ اِلٰى شَيْءٍ نُّكُرٍۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Fa tawalla ‘anhum, yauma yad‘ud-dā‘i ilā syai'in nukur(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: turn thou away from them. On the Day when the Summoning Voice will sum­mon [man] unto something that the mind cannot conceive,

ayahs.textArabic: خُشَّعًا اَبْصَارُهُمْ يَخْرُجُوْنَ مِنَ الْاَجْدَاثِ كَاَنَّهُمْ جَرَادٌ مُّنْتَشِرٌۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Khusysya‘an abṣāruhum yakhrujūna minal-ajdāṡi ka'annahum jarādum muntasyir(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: they will come forth from their graves, with their eyes downcast, [swarming about] like locusts scattered [by the wind],

ayahs.textArabic: مُّهْطِعِيْنَ اِلَى الدَّاعِۗ يَقُوْلُ الْكٰفِرُوْنَ هٰذَا يَوْمٌ عَسِرٌ
ayahs.textLatin: Muhṭi‘īna ilad-dā‘(i), yaqūlul-kāfirūna hāżā yaumun ‘asir(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: running in con­fusion towards the Summoning Voice; [and] those who [now] deny the truth will exclaim, “Calamitous is this Day!”

ayahs.textArabic: ۞ كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوْحٍ فَكَذَّبُوْا عَبْدَنَا وَقَالُوْا مَجْنُوْنٌ وَّازْدُجِرَ
ayahs.textLatin: Każżabat qablahum qaumu nūḥin fakażżabū ‘abdanā wa qālū majnūnuw wazdujir(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: [LONG] BEFORE those [who now deny resurrec­tion] did Noah’s people call it a lie; and they gave the lie to Our servant and said, “Mad is he!” - and he was repulsed.

ayahs.textArabic: فَدَعَا رَبَّهٗٓ اَنِّيْ مَغْلُوْبٌ فَانْتَصِرْ
ayahs.textLatin: Fa da‘ā rabbahū annī maglūbun fantaṣir.
ayahs.textEnglish: Thereupon he called out to his Sustainer, “Verily, I am defeated; come Thou, then, to my succour!”

ayahs.textArabic: فَفَتَحْنَآ اَبْوَابَ السَّمَاۤءِ بِمَاۤءٍ مُّنْهَمِرٍۖ
ayahs.textLatin: Fa fataḥnā abwābas-samā'i bimā'im munhamir(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: And so We caused the gates of heaven to open with water pouring down in torrents,

ayahs.textArabic: وَّفَجَّرْنَا الْاَرْضَ عُيُوْنًا فَالْتَقَى الْمَاۤءُ عَلٰٓى اَمْرٍ قَدْ قُدِرَ ۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa fajjarnal-arḍa ‘uyūnan faltaqal-mā'u ‘alā amrin qad qudir(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: and caused the earth to burst forth with springs, so that the waters met for a purpose pre-ordained:

ayahs.textArabic: وَحَمَلْنٰهُ عَلٰى ذَاتِ اَلْوَاحٍ وَّدُسُرٍۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa ḥamalnāhu ‘alā żāti alwāḥiw wa dusur(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: but him We bore on that [vessel] made of [mere] planks and nails,

ayahs.textArabic: تَجْرِيْ بِاَعْيُنِنَاۚ جَزَاۤءً لِّمَنْ كَانَ كُفِرَ
ayahs.textLatin: Tajrī bi'a‘yuninā, jazā'al liman kāna kufir(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: and it floated under Our eyes: a recom­pense for him who had been rejected with ingratitude.

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَقَدْ تَّرَكْنٰهَآ اٰيَةً فَهَلْ مِنْ مُّدَّكِرٍ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa laqat taraknāhā āyatan fahal mim muddakir(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: And, indeed, We have caused such [floating vessels] to remain forever a sign [of Our grace unto man]: who, then, is willing to take it to heart?

ayahs.textArabic: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِيْ وَنُذُرِ
ayahs.textLatin: Fa kaifa kāna ‘ażābī wa nużur(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: And how severe is the suffering which I inflict when My warnings are disregarded!

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا الْقُرْاٰنَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِنْ مُّدَّكِرٍ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa laqad yassarnal-qur'āna liż-żikri fahal mim muddakir(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: Hence, indeed, We made this Qur’an easy to bear in mind: who, then, is willing to take it to heart?

ayahs.textArabic: كَذَّبَتْ عَادٌ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِيْ وَنُذُرِ
ayahs.textLatin: Każżabat ‘ādun fa kaifa kāna ‘ażābī wa nużur(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: TO THE TRUTH gave the lie [the tribe of] Ad: and how severe was the suffering which I inflicted when My warnings were disregarded!

ayahs.textArabic: اِنَّآ اَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ رِيْحًا صَرْصَرًا فِيْ يَوْمِ نَحْسٍ مُّسْتَمِرٍّۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Innā arsalnā ‘alaihim rīḥan ṣarṣaran fī yaumi naḥsim mustamirr(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: Behold, We let loose upon them a raging storm wind on a day of bitter misfortune:

ayahs.textArabic: تَنْزِعُ النَّاسَۙ كَاَنَّهُمْ اَعْجَازُ نَخْلٍ مُّنْقَعِرٍ
ayahs.textLatin: Tanzi‘un-nās(a), ka'annahum a‘jāzu nakhlim munqa‘ir(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: it swept the people away as though they were palm-trunks uprooted:

ayahs.textArabic: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِيْ وَنُذُرِ
ayahs.textLatin: Fa kaifa kāna ‘ażābī wa nużur(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: for, how severe is the suffering which I inflict when My warnings are disregarded!

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا الْقُرْاٰنَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِنْ مُّدَّكِرٍ ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa laqad yassarnal-qur'āna liż-żikri fahal mim muddakir(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: Hence, indeed, We made this Qur’an easy to bear in mind: who, then, is willing to take it to heart?

ayahs.textArabic: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُوْدُ بِالنُّذُرِ
ayahs.textLatin: Każżabat ṡamūdu bin-nużur(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: [AND the tribe of] Thamud gave the lie to all [Our] warnings;

ayahs.textArabic: فَقَالُوْٓا اَبَشَرًا مِّنَّا وَاحِدًا نَّتَّبِعُهٗٓ  ۙاِنَّآ اِذًا لَّفِيْ ضَلٰلٍ وَّسُعُرٍ
ayahs.textLatin: Fa qālū abasyaram minnā wāḥidan nattabi‘uh(ū), innā iżal lafī ḍalāliw wa su‘ur(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: and they said: “Are we to follow one single mortal, one from among ourselves? In that case, behold, we would certainly sink into error and folly!

ayahs.textArabic: ءَاُلْقِيَ الذِّكْرُ عَلَيْهِ مِنْۢ بَيْنِنَا بَلْ هُوَ كَذَّابٌ اَشِرٌ
ayahs.textLatin: A'ulqiyaż-żikru ‘alaihi mim baininā bal huwa każżābun asyir(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: Why - on him alone from among all of us should a [divine] reminder have been bestowed? Nay, but he is a boastful liar!”

ayahs.textArabic: سَيَعْلَمُوْنَ غَدًا مَّنِ الْكَذَّابُ الْاَشِرُ
ayahs.textLatin: Saya‘lamūna gadam manil-każżābul-asyir(u).
ayahs.textEnglish: [And God said:] “On the morrow they will come to know who the boastful liar is!

ayahs.textArabic: اِنَّا مُرْسِلُوا النَّاقَةِ فِتْنَةً لَّهُمْ فَارْتَقِبْهُمْ وَاصْطَبِرْۖ
ayahs.textLatin: Innā mursilun-nāqati fitnatal lahum fartaqibhum waṣṭabir.
ayahs.textEnglish: Behold, [O Salih] We are letting loose this she-camel as a test for them; and thou but watch them, and contain thyself in patience.

ayahs.textArabic: وَنَبِّئْهُمْ اَنَّ الْمَاۤءَ قِسْمَةٌ ۢ بَيْنَهُمْۚ  كُلُّ شِرْبٍ مُّحْتَضَرٌ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa nabbi'hum annal-mā'a qismatum bainahum, kullu syirbim muḥtaḍar(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: And let them know that the water [of their wells] is to be divided between them, with each share of water equitably apportioned.”

ayahs.textArabic: فَنَادَوْا صَاحِبَهُمْ فَتَعَاطٰى فَعَقَرَ
ayahs.textLatin: Fa nādau ṣāḥibahum fa ta‘āṭā fa ‘aqar(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: But they summoned their [boldest] companion, and he ventured [upon the evil deed], and cruelly slaughtered [the animal]:

ayahs.textArabic: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِيْ وَنُذُرِ
ayahs.textLatin: Fakaifa kāna ‘ażābī wa nużur(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: and how severe was the suffering which I inflicted when My warnings were disregarded!

ayahs.textArabic: اِنَّآ اَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ صَيْحَةً وَّاحِدَةً فَكَانُوْا كَهَشِيْمِ الْمُحْتَظِرِ
ayahs.textLatin: Innā arsalnā ‘alaihim ṣaiḥataw wāḥidatan fa kānū kahasyīmil-muḥtaẓir(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: Behold, We let loose upon them one single blast [of Our punishment], and they became like the dried-up, crumbling twigs of a sheepfold.

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا الْقُرْاٰنَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِنْ مُّدَّكِرٍ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa laqad yassarnal-qur'āna liż-żikri fahal mim muddakir(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: Hence, indeed, We made this Qur’an easy to bear in mind: who, then, is willing to take it to heart?

ayahs.textArabic: كَذَّبَتْ قَوْمُ لُوْطٍ ۢبِالنُّذُرِ
ayahs.textLatin: Każżabat qaumu lūṭim bin-nużur(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: LOT ’S PEOPLE [too] gave the lie to all [Our] warn­ings:

ayahs.textArabic: اِنَّآ اَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ حَاصِبًا اِلَّآ اٰلَ لُوْطٍ ۗنَجَّيْنٰهُمْ بِسَحَرٍۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Innā arsalnā ‘alaihim ḥāṣiban illā āla lūṭ(in), najjaināhum bisaḥar(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: [and so,] behold, We let loose upon them a deadly tempest; and only Lot ’s kinsfolk did We save at the break of dawn,

ayahs.textArabic: نِّعْمَةً مِّنْ عِنْدِنَاۗ  كَذٰلِكَ نَجْزِيْ مَنْ شَكَرَ
ayahs.textLatin: Ni‘matam min ‘indinā, każālika najzī man syakar(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: as a blessing from Us: thus do We reward all who are grateful.

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَقَدْ اَنْذَرَهُمْ بَطْشَتَنَا فَتَمَارَوْا بِالنُّذُرِ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa laqad anżarahum baṭsyatanā fa tamārau bin-nużur(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: For he had truly warned them of Our punishing might; but they stubbornly cast doubt on these warn­ings,

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَقَدْ رَاوَدُوْهُ عَنْ ضَيْفِهٖ فَطَمَسْنَآ اَعْيُنَهُمْ فَذُوْقُوْا عَذَابِيْ وَنُذُرِ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa laqad rāwadūhu ‘an ḍaifihī fa ṭamasnā a‘yunahum fa żūqū ‘ażābī wa nużur(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: and even demanded that he give up his guests [to them]: whereupon We deprived them of their sight [and thus told them, as it were]: “Taste, then, the suffering which I inflict when My warnings are disregarded!”

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَقَدْ صَبَّحَهُمْ بُكْرَةً عَذَابٌ مُّسْتَقِرٌّۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa laqad ṣabbaḥahum bukratan ‘ażābum mustaqirr(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: And, indeed, abiding suffering did befall them early on the morrow:

ayahs.textArabic: فَذُوْقُوْا عَذَابِيْ وَنُذُرِ
ayahs.textLatin: Fa żūqū ‘ażābī wa nużur(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: “Taste, then, the suffering which I inflict when My warnings are disregarded!”

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا الْقُرْاٰنَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِنْ مُّدَّكِرٍ ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa laqad yassarnal-qur'āna liż-żikri fahal mim muddakir(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: Hence, indeed, We made this Qur’an easy to bear in mind: who, then, is willing to take it to heart?

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَقَدْ جَاۤءَ اٰلَ فِرْعَوْنَ النُّذُرُۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa laqad jā'a āla fir‘aunan-nużur(u).
ayahs.textEnglish: Now surely, unto Pharaoh’s folk [too] came such warnings;

ayahs.textArabic: كَذَّبُوْا بِاٰيٰتِنَا كُلِّهَا فَاَخَذْنٰهُمْ اَخْذَ عَزِيْزٍ مُّقْتَدِرٍ
ayahs.textLatin: Każżabū bi'āyātinā kullihā fa'akhażnāhum akhża ‘azīzim muqtadir(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: they, too, gave the lie to all Our messages: and thereupon We took them to task as only the Almighty, who determines all things, can take to task.

ayahs.textArabic: اَكُفَّارُكُمْ خَيْرٌ مِّنْ اُولٰۤىِٕكُمْ اَمْ لَكُمْ بَرَاۤءَةٌ فِى الزُّبُرِۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Akuffārukum khairum min ulā'ikum am lakum barā'atun fiz-zubur(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: ARE, THEN, those of you who [now] deny the truth better than those others - or have you, per­chance, [been promised] immunity in the [ancient] books of [divine] wisdom?

ayahs.textArabic: اَمْ يَقُوْلُوْنَ نَحْنُ جَمِيْعٌ مُّنْتَصِرٌ
ayahs.textLatin: Am yaqūlūna naḥnu jamī‘um muntaṣir(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: Or do they say, “We are a group united, [and therefore] bound to prevail”?

ayahs.textArabic: سَيُهْزَمُ الْجَمْعُ وَيُوَلُّوْنَ الدُّبُرَ
ayahs.textLatin: Sayuhzamul-jam‘u wa yuwallūnad-dubur(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: [Yet] the hosts [of those who deny the truth] shall be routed, and they shall turn their backs [in flight]!

ayahs.textArabic: بَلِ السَّاعَةُ مَوْعِدُهُمْ وَالسَّاعَةُ اَدْهٰى وَاَمَرُّ
ayahs.textLatin: Balis-sā‘atu mau‘iduhum was-sā‘atu adhā wa amarr(u).
ayahs.textEnglish: But nay - the Last Hour is the time when they shall truly meet their fate; and that Last Hour will be most calamitous, and most bitter:

ayahs.textArabic: اِنَّ الْمُجْرِمِيْنَ فِيْ ضَلٰلٍ وَّسُعُرٍۘ
ayahs.textLatin: Innal-mujrimīna fī ḍalāliw wa su‘ur(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: for, behold, those who are lost in sin [will at that time come to know that it is they who] were sunk in error and folly!

ayahs.textArabic: يَوْمَ يُسْحَبُوْنَ فِى النَّارِ عَلٰى وُجُوْهِهِمْۗ ذُوْقُوْا مَسَّ سَقَرَ
ayahs.textLatin: Yauma yusḥabūna fin-nāri ‘alā wujūhihim, żūqū massa saqar(a).
ayahs.textEnglish: On the Day when they shall be dragged into the fire on their faces, [they will be told:] “Taste now the touch of hell-fire!”

ayahs.textArabic: اِنَّا كُلَّ شَيْءٍ خَلَقْنٰهُ بِقَدَرٍ
ayahs.textLatin: Innā kulla syai'in khalaqnāhu biqadar(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: BEHOLD, everything have We created in due measure and proportion;

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَآ اَمْرُنَآ اِلَّا وَاحِدَةٌ كَلَمْحٍ ۢبِالْبَصَرِ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa mā amrunā illā wāḥidatun kalamḥim bil-baṣar(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: and Our ordaining [a thing and its coming into being] is but one [act], like the twinkling of an eye.

ayahs.textArabic: وَلَقَدْ اَهْلَكْنَآ اَشْيَاعَكُمْ فَهَلْ مِنْ مُّدَّكِرٍ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa laqad ahlaknā asy-yā‘akum fahal mim muddakir(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: Thus, indeed, did We destroy people like you [in the past]: who, then, is willing to take it to heart?

ayahs.textArabic: وَكُلُّ شَيْءٍ فَعَلُوْهُ فِى الزُّبُرِ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa kullu syai'in fa‘alūhu fiz-zubur(i).
ayahs.textEnglish: [They were truly guilty] because all [the evil] that they ever did had been [revealed to them as such] in the [ancient] books of [divine] wisdom;

ayahs.textArabic: وَكُلُّ صَغِيْرٍ وَّكَبِيْرٍ مُّسْتَطَرٌ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa kullu ṣagīriw wa kabīrim mustaṭar(un).
ayahs.textEnglish: and everything [that man does], be it small or great, is recorded [with God].

ayahs.textArabic: اِنَّ الْمُتَّقِيْنَ فِيْ جَنّٰتٍ وَّنَهَرٍۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Innal-muttaqīna fī jannātiw wa nahar(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: [Hence, too,] behold, the God-conscious will find themselves in [a paradise of] gardens and running waters,

ayahs.textArabic: فِيْ مَقْعَدِ صِدْقٍ عِنْدَ مَلِيْكٍ مُّقْتَدِرٍ ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Fī maq‘adi ṣidqin ‘inda malīkim muqtadir(in).
ayahs.textEnglish: in a seat of truth, in the presence of a Sovereign who determines all things.
